reads_as: a sweating, bug-eyed anime/Naruto crying face screaming regret beside an 'I Wish I Knew' headline
layout_map: Dark blue graph-paper grid background full-bleed. A distorted, sweating yellow-haired anime crying face (Naruto deep-fried meme) fills the left ~40% of frame, cells 1-2-5-6-9-10, head center ~x230,y220, jaw/'luh?' caption tag near cell 13 ~y600. Two-line headline sits right-center: 'I Wish' in white Inter-900 caps on row 1 baseline ~y230 cells 7-8, 'I Knew' below it on a red filled block, white text, baseline ~y330 cells 7-8. Floating tech logos decorate the right margin: Python logo top-right cell 4 ~x1180,y110, a C/C++ blue badge cell 13-14 lower-left ~x200,y640, a red Reddit/snapchat-style icon bottom-right cell 16 ~x1180,y660. Device = shocked deep-fried face plus red accent block.
why_it_works: the deep-fried sweating regret face triggers second-hand panic; the red 'I Knew' block lands the FOMO payoff word
mimic_for: a regret/hindsight beat — things you wish you'd known earlier about a topic
title: Programming Concepts NOBODY Taught Me

mimic_for: a contrarian hot-take beat that rejects the conventional advice (stop doing X, just do Y)
title: STOP Studying. Start Coding.
